desc:
Genovia High 🌹 
.•° ✿ °•.

☆. ┊ Attend a royal boarding school that's soul purpose is to educate the upcoming royals. 👑 
☆. ┊ Roleplay as a royal student.
☆. ┊ Dress up in our school uniforms.
☆. ┊ Attend your royal classes such as etiquette & manners, fencing, horseback riding, theater, etc. 
☆. ┊ Take care of your hunger, hygiene, and energy by visiting rooms the staff prepares for you. 🛌🏼
☆. ┊ Attend the special event weekends! (School dance, Talent Show)
☆. ┊ Claim the most comfy bed in the Genovia High dorms.
☆. ┊ Make memories and friends along the way! 🎥
